run_bisection_debug: run bisection debugging on a command with a specified range and timeout to find failing inputs
run_bisection_comma_join: run bisection debugging with comma-joined range arguments for tools like pnacl-sz
run_bisection_template: run bisection debugging using a template command with %i placeholders for range substitution
run_bisection_find_all: run bisection debugging to find all failing combinations rather than stopping at the first
run_bisection_custom_range: run bisection debugging with a custom start and end range for the initial test interval
